title: TensorHub: Scalable and Elastic Weight Transfer for LLM RL Training
abstract: arXiv:2604.09107v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern LLM reinforcement learning (RL) workloads require a high-performance weight transfer system to scale training across heterogeneous compute resources. However, efficiently transferring terabyte-scale model weights across thousands of GPUs remains challenging because the system must accommodate clusters that dynamically scale up and down while keeping coordination, data movement, and storage overhead low.   We introduce Reference-Oriented Storage (ROS), a new storage abstraction for RL weight transfer that exploits highly replicated model weights in place. ROS presents the illusion that certain versions of the model weights are stored and can be fetched on demand. Underneath, ROS does not physically store any copies of the weights; instead, it tracks the workers that hold these weights on GPUs for inference. Upon request, ROS directly uses them to serve reads. translated_title: TensorHub：面向大语言模型强化学习训练的可扩展弹性权重传输系统
translated_abstract: 现代大语言模型（LLM）强化学习（RL）工作负载需要高性能的权重传输系统，以便在异构计算资源之间扩展训练。然而，在数千个GPU之间高效传输TB级别的模型权重仍然具有挑战性，因为系统必须适应动态扩容和缩容的集群，同时保持协调、数据移动和存储开销处于较低水平。我们提出了面向引用的存储（Reference-Oriented Storage，ROS），这是一种用于RL权重传输的新型存储抽象，它充分利用高度复制的模型权重并进行原位使用。ROS呈现出一种假象，即某些版本的模型权重已被存储并可按需获取。而在底层，ROS并不物理存储任何权重副本；相反，它跟踪在GPU上持有这些权重用于推理的工作节点。收到请求时，ROS直接使用这些权重来服务读取。我们构建了TensorHub，这是一个实现了该抽象的生产级系统。
tldr: 提出面向引用的存储（ROS）抽象，通过跟踪而非物理复制GPU上已有的模型权重来实现原位读取，并据此构建TensorHub系统，为大语言模型强化学习训练提供可扩展、弹性且低开销的TB级权重传输方案。
en_tdlr: Proposes Reference-Oriented Storage (ROS), a storage abstraction that tracks rather than physically replicates model weights held on GPUs for inference, and builds TensorHub, a production-quality system providing scalable and elastic terabyte-scale weight transfer for LLM RL training.
